audience: compliance teams that screen customers, suppliers and payees against sanctions and PEP lists

useCases.title: Screen a company name against the sanctions lists
useCases.text: List the screening sources and their short codes. Then screen the company name against the sources you choose. Each match is a lead for human review.

useCases.title: Screen a person by name and date of birth
useCases.text: Screen a person's name with the date of birth and country to narrow the matches. Each match has a confidence score from 0 to 1.

useCases.title: Screen a vessel or an aircraft
useCases.text: Screen a vessel or an aircraft by name against sanctions and watchlists. Add its identifier as an extra field. Review each match before any decision.
